notes.title: Basic modifications
notes.content: I modified the game's introduction. In which the character has several doors, now with only one. I will soon add a translator for the texts to English. A new episode of the story will also be released soon.

notes.title: Chapter 2 only in 2025 and changes to the first game
notes.content:
We will make a modification to the game to suit the chapters. These upcoming chapters will be separate applications from the first game. With each chapter, you must start at one level ahead, without the need to level everything up again. We are developing another project, a racing game, which is why Darklands was left out of our plans. But a new chapter should be ready in 2025. I apologize for the delay, but we have a lot of events and work here. We didn't forget you! If you want a key to learn about the game, just ask us via repost. Thanks!

PS: 
We will translate the texts into English, but Engine works in Portuguese and unfortunately we cannot change this at the moment, due to the complexity of the program itself.

notes.title: I want my key and a game!
notes.content: You can still ask us for a key and be able to play Darklands: The Chapters for free. Additionally, if you give our game a positive review, you will win a raffle number for any game on Steam worth up to $15. For the draw to take place, we must have at least 12 reviews done on the Darklands page/store. The draw date will only be scheduled after meeting this objective of having at least 12 analyzes of the game. I will already be announcing the draw numbers to those who analyzed. Thanks!

notes.content:

Livy Arthur[/h3]

notes.title: Darklands Promotional
notes.content:
Darklands Promotional

Hello people,

It is with great pleasure that I publish my game Darklands: The Chapters on Steam. Previously I had developed the Topper Carrier game, but doing some tests I realized that it was failing on some types of screens with faster DPIs, and even crashing on machines with processors up to 4 cores. So I had to withdraw it from sale, unfortunately. I was very upset with the results and decided to abandon Construct 3 and use Unity and RPG Maker MZ. The result was that for RPG Maker I developed this game, which really works. I hope to be able to translate it into other languages ​​besides Portuguese, as unfortunately I am limited in this aspect at the moment. I work alone here and elsewhere, but I'm about to expand the business here. Thank you to everyone who accompanies me. I now hope to bring games with more quality and with as few problems as possible. Oh, anyone who wants the keys can contact me, I'm delivering them slowly, but it's being done. Thanks!

Livy Arthur
